image_title: Ablations on Tool Position and Training Robustness
summary: The visual presents two charts related to the accuracy gain of different methods in a study on tool position and training robustness. The left chart shows the accuracy gain (%) for TTRL (blue line) and AIME (red line) against verified voting weight, with AIME achieving a peak accuracy gain of +31.6% and MATH at +2.2%. The right chart compares the accuracy gain (%) of TTRL_Agent and T^3RL across three categories: AIME (+31.6%), AMC (-19.0%), and MATH500 (-23.0%). Additionally, it shows training robustness comparison with TTRL yielding a standard deviation of 2.638 and variance of 6.959. The overall trend indicates that TTRL outperforms the other methods in accuracy gain, particularly in the AIME category. The source of the data is indicated as Figure 8.
